name: Next Best Action channel scores
platform: Data Cloud Model Builder (three CatBoost binary classifiers inside one batch transform)
summary: Three scores on every recent lead: how likely they are to click a text, open the first email, and phone us. The call and text scores decide whether a lead stalled at the review step gets a call task, a text, or both.
predicts: Text click within 14 days, first journey email opened, inbound call within 30 days.
population: Leads created in the last 14 days, about 4,400 at a time, rescored every hour.
usedFor: Routing in the Review quote-step journey (v17), which is also the test of whether model routing beats random routing.

components.name: Predicted SMS
components.note: 9 inputs. Text-born leads removed from training (they counted their own creation as a click).

components.name: Predicted Opened_First_Email
components.note: 11 inputs. Email domain is the strongest. Not used for routing today.

components.name: Predicted Call
components.note: 11 inputs. Training starts 2025-05-02, when call tickets can be tied to a lead.

retired: The three legacy models (Predicted Is Phone / SMS / Email V2) are disabled. They had learned purchase intent, not channel preference, and showed no lift in the Jan to Sep 2026 holdout (10.2% vs 11.9% control).

outputs.note: 0 to 100; text when 39.8 or higher (top half)
arm the lead was routed to at journey entry

quality.passLine: Training AUC at least 0.58 with no leaking input among the top contributors. In market: model-routed arm ahead of random on 30-day purchase.

manualTasks.title: Monthly test read
manualTasks.why: The journey is a test. Arms are only comparable once 30 days have passed since entry, and the harm stop is checked at each read.
steps: Pull entrants by NBA_Test_Arm__c and NBA_Assignment__c from Lead (the Journey Builder population counter reads 0; do not use it).
Month 1: reach rate per call arm, text click rate, opt-outs, call volume, score distribution of the model-routed path.
From month 2: 30-day purchase by arm for leads with 30 days of follow-up.
Stop an arm if it is more than 3 points worse than the best arm with probability above 0.90.

manualTasks.title: Retrain the three models
manualTasks.cadence: Quarterly, or sooner if a monthly read shows the scores drifting
manualTasks.why: Training is manual (Schedule Training is left on Manual in Model Builder). The training files are point-in-time CSV uploads, so new history only arrives when the files are rebuilt.
steps: Rebuild the three point-in-time CSVs with pit_pull_ci.py and pit_build.py.
Upload each as a file data stream and map it to its training data model object.
Retrain each model in Model Builder with the filters and exclusions in POINT_IN_TIME_SNAPSHOT.md.
Gate: AUC at least 0.58 and no current-state or leaking input in the top contributors.
Open Channel_Scores_Models in the Data Cloud UI and point each AI node at the new version (the API refuses any change to a transform that contains a model node).

manualTasks.title: Reset the routing thresholds
manualTasks.why: The cut points are percentiles of the score distribution (call at the 80th percentile, text at the median). A new model version shifts both.
steps: Take the 80th percentile of Call_Score__c and the median of SMS_Score__c on the first full scoring run.
Update the Predicted_Channel__c formula (42.3 and 39.8 today) and deploy.

manualTasks.title: Protect the hourly schedules
manualTasks.cadence: Whenever a transform or its schedule is edited
manualTasks.why: An hourly Data Cloud schedule only runs from its start hour to midnight, and the UI dialog only offers on-the-hour times. Saving from the UI silently cuts the chain to a few runs a day and breaks the :00 / :35 / :10 order.
steps: Never save a schedule from the UI dialog.
Set schedules by API with start hour 0 and the right minute (bodies are in the transforms folder).
After any edit, check run history shows one run every hour.

openItems: Every hourly run re-stamps the scoring date, so about 4,400 leads are updated every hour (roughly 100,000 Lead updates a day through flows and the Marketing Cloud sync). A daily stamp would cut that.
The entry query accepts leads last modified by three system users. A new integration user touching leads would block entries until its id is added.

Legacy transforms LeadMultiChannelScoring and ChannelPredictionTrainingData are still active (unscheduled); Channel_Scores_Field__dlm is empty; the three prediction objects from the old predict jobs can be deleted.
Scores reach Lead 1.5 to 3.5 hours after the lead is created.
